Lessons.Title: Finding Intersections
ExplanationParagraphs: Source-aligned goals: Calculate the solution to a system of polynomial equations.

A solution to f(x)=g(x) provides the horizontal coordinate of the intersection; evaluating either function gives its shared vertical coordinate. Algebraic solutions must be turned into ordered points and checked on both graphs.

Source activity 11.1: Math Talk: When $f$ Meets $g$: Mentally identify a point where the graphs of the two functions intersect, if one exists. \(f(x)=x\) and \(g(x)=3\) \(j(x)=(x+3)(x-3)\) and \(k(x)=0\) \(m(x)=(x+3)(x-3)\) and \(n(x)=(x-3)\) \(p(x)=(x+5)(x-5)\) and \(q(x)=(x+3)(x-3)\) Explain the mathematical model, verify the relevant result and have a teacher inspect original diagrams or discussion evidence.

Source activity 11.2: More Points of Intersection: For each pair of polynomials given, find all points of intersection of their graphs. \(c(x)=x^2-7\) and \(d(x)=2\) \(f(x)=(x+7)(x-4)\) and \(g(x)=x-4\) \(m(x)=(x+7)(x-4)\) and \(n(x)=(2x+5)(x-4)\) \(p(x)=(x+1)(x-8)\) and \(q(x)=(x+2)(x-4)\) Find all points of intersection of the graphs of the equations \(p(x)=(2x+3)(x-5)\) and \(q(x)=(x+5)(x+1)(x-3)\). Use graphing technology… Explain the mathematical model, verify the relevant result and have a teacher inspect original diagrams or discussion evidence.

Source activity 11.3: Graphing to Find Points of Intersection: Consider the functions \(p(x) = 5x^3+6x^2+4x\) and \(q(x) = 5640\). Use graphing technology to find a value of \(x\) that makes \(p(x)=q(x)\) true. For the \(x\)-value at the point of intersection, what can you say about the value of \(5x^3+6x^2+4x-5640\)? What does your answer suggest is a possible factor of \(5x^3+6x^2+4x-5640\)? Write your own polynomial \(m(x)\) of degree… Explain the mathematical model, verify the relevant result and have a teacher inspect original diagrams or discussion evidence.

Practice Problem 1: What are the points of intersection between the graphs of the functions \(f(x)=x^2(x+1)\) and \(g(x)=x+1\)? Preserve original numbers, constraints and representations in a student practice task.

Practice Problem 2: Select all the points of intersection between the graphs of the functions \(f(x)=(x+5)(x-2)\) and \(g(x)=(2x+1)(x-2)\). \((\text-\frac12, 0)\) \((\text-2,\text-12)\) Preserve original numbers, constraints and representations in a student practice task.
Practice Problem 3: What are the solutions to the equation \((x-3)(x+5)=\text-15\)? Preserve original numbers, constraints and representations in a student practice task.

Practice Problem 4: What are the \(x\)-intercepts of the graph of \(y=(5x+7)(2x-1)(x-4)\)? \(\text-\frac75, \text{-}\frac12, 4\) \(\frac57, \frac12, 4\) \(\text{-}\frac75, \frac12, 4\) Preserve original numbers, constraints and representations in a student practice task.

Practice Problem 5: Which polynomial function’s graph is shown here? \(f(x)=(x+1)(x+2)(x+4)\) \(f(x)=(x+1)(x-2)(x+4)\) \(f(x)=(x-1)(x+2)(x-4)\) \(f(x)=(x-1)(x-2)(x-4)\) Preserve original numbers, constraints and representations in a student practice task.
Practice Problem 6: Draw a rough sketch of the graph of \(g(x)=\text-x^2(x+2)\). Preserve original numbers, constraints and representations in a student practice task.

Practice Problem 7: The graph of a polynomial function \(f\) is shown. Is the degree of the polynomial odd or even? Explain how you know. What is the constant term of the polynomial? Preserve original numbers, constraints and representations in a student practice task.
Edulytics independent cool-down: Solve intersections of y=x^2-1 and y=2x-1. Expected reasoning or answer: (0,-1) and (2,3).
